summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to transform the DeRote Student Portal into a premium, personalized student productivity dashboard for Classes 8, 9, and 10. Features a signature royal-blue sidebar with sculpted curved edges, four integrated views (Overview, My Tasks, My Reflections, and Profile & Customization), three accent themes (Classic Royal Blue, Slate Teal, Indigo Violet), and persistent Firestore data storage for tasks and preferences.
